items.title: Eek! The Cat
items.description:
Eek! The Cat (retitled Eek! Stravaganza in 1994) is an American-Canadian animated series, created by Savage Steve Holland and Bill Kopp and produced by Fox Kids and Savage Studios with animation by Nelvana. It ran from 1992 to 1997 on Fox Kids, airing on YTV from 1992 to 1998 in Canada.
